items.title: 25.2 Retrosynthesis and Synthesis of Some Compounds

source_refs.note: Topic 25.2 with the cholesterol box and Quick Check 25.2, answered (PDF 137-139); the examples are redrawn. The ethyl acetate Step II text says 'benzene and nitric acid' (copied from the aniline example); the lesson gives acetic acid and ethanol. Answers need review.

items: Disconnection: breaking the ester C-O bond gives synthon A, the acylium ion CH3CO+, and synthon B, the ethoxide ion C2H5O-.
Synthetic equivalents: CH3CO+ is supplied by ethanoic (acetic) acid and C2H5O- by ethanol.
Synthesis: esterification, CH3COOH + C2H5OH -> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O (concentrated H2SO4).
FGI: the amino group is changed into a nitro group, because a nitro group is easily put on benzene by electrophilic substitution, whereas an amino group cannot be put on by nucleophilic substitution.
Disconnection: breaking the C-N bond of nitrobenzene gives the aryl anion C6H5- and the nitronium ion NO2+.
Synthetic equivalents and synthesis: benzene and nitric acid; nitrate benzene (HNO3, H2SO4), then reduce nitrobenzene with Sn and HCl.
Disconnection: breaking the C-C bond between the ring and the C=O group gives the aryl anion C6H5- and the acylium cation CH3CO+.
Synthetic equivalents: benzene and ethanoyl (acyl) chloride.
Synthesis: Friedel-Crafts acylation, C6H6 + CH3COCl -> C6H5COCH3 + HCl (AlCl3 catalyst).

blocks.alt: Three panels. Ethyl ethanoate: CH3CO-OC2H5 with a red slash on the C-O bond, disconnected into CH3CO+ (synthon A) and C2H5O- (synthon B), with SE ethanoic acid and ethanol, and the esterification equation. Aniline: benzene with HNO3/H2SO4 gives nitrobenzene, which Sn/HCl reduces to aniline. Phenylethanone: benzene + CH3COCl with AlCl3 gives phenylethanone + HCl.
blocks.caption: Retrosynthesis and synthesis of ethyl ethanoate, aniline and phenylethanone (original diagram after the book's examples).
blocks.long_description: In each example the bond to the functional group is disconnected, the two charged synthons are matched with real reagents, and the forward synthesis then uses a reaction already met: esterification, nitration and reduction, or Friedel-Crafts acylation.

blocks.title: Interesting information
blocks.text: The landmark synthesis of cholesterol was first achieved in the early 1950s by two competing groups, led by Robert Robinson at Oxford and R. B. Woodward at Harvard.

items: Why is benzene nitrated during the synthesis of aniline?
Phenyl ethanoate, CH3COOC6H5, is used in making medicines. Give its retrosynthetic tree, synthetic equivalents and a synthesis.
